Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG and published by Protermify Aviation as a static aviation reference page.

Definition

Presence of water, biological growth, particulates or other foreign matter in aviation fuel that renders it unserviceable.

Operational example

Ground Control: Stand 36 closed; fuel contamination reported in hydrant line, all traffic reassign to stand 28 until investigation complete.
